definitions.explanation: The direction in which a ship or aircraft is traveling or should travel. A technical term used in navigation.
The direction or path one takes in life or in pursuing a goal. Used metaphorically.

examples.japanese: ⟦{船長|せんちょう}→船長：18291_senchou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：03616_henkou⟧。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧⟦により→によって：06801_niyotte⟧、{針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{北|きた}→北：00644_kita⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: Due to the approaching typhoon, we set a northward course.
examples.notes: 針路を取る = to set a course

examples.japanese: ⟦{嵐|あらし}→嵐：01695_arashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{船|ふね}→船：00775_fune⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}えて→変える：01089_kaeru⟧⟦{南|みなみ}→南：00652_minami⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: To avoid the storm, the ship changed course significantly and headed south.

examples.japanese: {針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧{針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{示|しめ}す→示す：01948_shimesu⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The company needs to show a new direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{針路|しんろ}⟦{転換|てんかん}→転換：19439_tenkan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迫|せま}られている→迫る：03928_semaru⟧。
examples.english: The country's economic policy is being forced into a major change of course.
examples.notes: 針路転換 = change of course/direction

notes:
USAGE: {針路|しんろ} literally means 'needle path' (referring to a compass needle) and is primarily used in nautical and aviation contexts. In everyday language, ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧ (direction) or ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧ (course, path) are more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：03616_henkou⟧ (to change course)
- {針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to set a course)
- {針路|しんろ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧ (to determine the course)

HOMOPHONE: ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧ means 'one's way forward, career path, route' - same reading but different meaning and usage.
